description: This PHP source file defines the class OX_Video_Report, which handles video ad statistics, including fetching VAST ad metrics, generating fake data, and checking VAST presence for various entities within an ad server system.

classes.name: OX_Video_Report
classes.description: A class for managing and retrieving video ad statistics, including VAST event tracking, data aggregation, and fake data generation for testing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes table name properties based on global configuration.

methods.name: getDateTimeInUtc
methods.description: Converts a date string to UTC datetime format.

methods.name: getVastStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves VAST ad event statistics for specified entities and date ranges, with optional filtering.

methods.name: doesAdvertiserHaveVast
methods.description: Checks if an advertiser has VAST ads.

methods.name: doesCampaignHaveVast
methods.description: Checks if a campaign has VAST ads.

methods.name: doesBannerHaveVast
methods.description: Checks if a banner has VAST ads.

methods.name: isZoneVast
methods.description: Determines if a zone is of a VAST video type.

methods.name: doesEntityHaveVast
methods.description: Helper method to check if an entity (via SQL from and where clauses) has VAST ads.

methods.name: doesWebsiteHaveVast
methods.description: Checks if a website (affiliate) has VAST ads.

methods.name: getDateLabelsBetweenDates
methods.description: Generates date labels between two dates based on the specified dimension (day, week, month, year, hour).

methods.name: getSqlFieldNameFromDimension
methods.description: Returns the SQL field for display name based on the dimension.

methods.name: getSqlFieldFromDimension
methods.description: Returns the SQL field for the dimension used in queries.

methods.name: getSummaryRowFromDataTable
methods.description: Aggregates metrics across all data rows to produce a summary.

methods.name: getColumnsIdToNameInOrder
methods.description: Returns ordered column names for graph display based on event IDs.

methods.name: getDataTableForGraphCount
methods.description: Prepares data for graph plotting with raw counts.

methods.name: getDataTableForGraphPercentage
methods.description: Prepares data for graph plotting with percentage values.

methods.name: generateFakeVastStatistics
methods.description: Creates fake VAST ad event data over past days for testing purposes.
